messages:
sasha: who else is watching the 89th minute? ramen + red card energy over here. :eyes:
jamie: noooo my fantasy goalie got red carded. subbed in someone on the IR list. rules, pls.
omar: you cant bench IRL-injured players right? this seems illegal. :laughing:
tanya: ref was diet chaos. also anyone down for a post-game ramen run at 10? the place by the office is open late.
sasha: @tanya Im in 1 I'll bring extra napkins.
jamie: Ill bring those instant cups from the pantry for quick fixes. :ramen: 
omar: Ill pop by for chips too. lowkey want OT so I can finish one more review before leaving.
snack-bot: Reminder: office-snacks signup closes in 30m. Reply with "+1 ramen" to be added.
jamie: +1 ramen
tanya: +1 ramen (and kimchi, fight me)
sasha: +1 ramen. also petition to change fantasy goalie red card scoring.
omar: petition name: "Stop Destroying Benches" :pray:
jamie: quick poll: next fantasy playoff prize - pizza party (:pizza:) or gift card (:money_with_wings:)? react with emoji to vote.
tanya: :pizza: (always pizza)
sasha: :money_with_wings: if tie -> pizza + ramen night.
omar: agreed. match was a soap opera. ramen therapy recommended.
